description: Complete entity definitions, field specifications, and DTOs for the TravelHues travel creator platform

User.description: Core user account for both travelers (USER) and travel creators (CREATOR). Single auth table with role-based differentiation.

email.description: Unique email address used for login

passwordHash.description: Bcrypt hashed password. Null for OAuth-only accounts

phone.description: Optional phone number with country code

avatarUrl.description: URL to profile avatar image stored in MinIO/S3

role.description: Platform role. CREATOR can have a storefront and portfolio

isEmailVerified.description: Whether email has been confirmed via verification link

oauthProvider.description: OAuth provider name: google, apple, facebook

passwordResetToken.description: Hashed token for password reset flow

passwordResetExpiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp for password reset token

creatorProfile.description: Extended profile data for CREATOR role users

orders.description: All purchase orders made by this user

subscriptions.description: All subscriptions this user has (platform + creator subs)

uploads.description: Media files uploaded by this user

CreatorProfile.description: Extended profile for CREATOR role users. Contains public-facing portfolio details, Stripe Connect account info, and aggregated stats.

displayName.description: Public creator name shown on storefront

tagline.description: Short one-liner headline displayed under display name

socialLinks.description: Social media URLs: { instagram, twitter, youtube, tiktok, facebook }

creatorTier.description: Creator subscription tier determining platform features

stripeAccountId.description: Stripe Connect Express/Standard account ID for payouts

totalFollowers.description: Denormalized follower count for display performance

totalSales.description: Total number of products sold across all time

totalRevenue.description: Total lifetime revenue earned on platform

averageRating.description: Rolling average of all product and creator reviews

featuredUntil.description: If set, creator is shown in featured section until this date

user.description: The user account this profile belongs to

portfolios.description: All portfolio collections created by this creator

Portfolio.description: A named collection of portfolio items (travel photos/stories) created by a creator. One creator can have multiple portfolios.

description.description: Long description of what this portfolio covers

coverImageUrl.description: Hero image URL for this portfolio

isPublished.description: Whether this portfolio is visible to the public

viewCount.description: Total number of times this portfolio has been viewed

featuredOrder.description: Sort order when displayed as featured on creator profile. Null = not featured

creator.description: The creator who owns this portfolio

items.description: All media items within this portfolio

PortfolioItem.description: An individual media entry (photo, gallery, story) within a portfolio collection.

description.description: Caption, story or description of the image/video

mediaUrls.description: Array of media file URLs (supports multi-photo carousels)

mediaTypes.description: Type corresponding to each mediaUrl entry

location.description: Geographic location where media was captured

viewCount.description: View count for this specific item

likeCount.description: Number of likes on this item

portfolio.description: Parent portfolio this item belongs to

Storefront.description: The creator's public shop page. One-to-one with CreatorProfile. Contains branding, slug for URL, and aggregated revenue stats.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier e.g. 'nomad-adventures'. Used in /shop/{slug}

bannerUrl.description: Wide banner/hero image for storefront header

themeColor.description: Hex color code for storefront accent color e.g. '#E87C2A'

customDomain.description: Optional custom domain for Pro/Premium creators e.g. 'shop.creator.com'

totalRevenue.description: Denormalized total revenue for quick display

creator.description: The creator who owns this storefront

products.description: All products listed in this storefront

Product.description: A sellable item in a creator's storefront. Can be digital (itinerary PDF, preset pack, guide) or a service (consultation, experience).

creatorId.description: Foreign key to creator_profiles.id (denormalized for query performance)

description.description: Full product description with feature list, what's included

type.description: Product category determining display and behavior

price.description: Price in smallest unit representation (display as dollars)

isPublished.description: Whether product appears in storefront listings

isDigital.description: True for digital downloads; false for services/physical

fileUrl.description: Private MinIO/S3 URL for digital product file. Only exposed post-purchase

fileSize.description: File size in bytes for digital products

fileMimeType.description: MIME type of digital file e.g. application/pdf

stock.description: Available stock. Null = unlimited (default for digital products)

stripePriceId.description: Stripe Price ID for checkout sessions

totalSold.description: Total units sold across all time

averageRating.description: Rolling average rating from verified reviews

reviewCount.description: Total number of reviews for this product

metadata.description: Type-specific metadata e.g. { days: 7, destinations: [...] } for itineraries

storefront.description: The storefront this product belongs to

orderItems.description: All order line items for this product

Order.description: A purchase transaction by a user. May contain multiple products from a single creator (per-creator checkout model).

creatorId.description: Foreign key to creator_profiles.id (seller). One order per creator per checkout.

subtotal.description: Sum of all line item totals before tax

platformFee.description: Platform commission taken from order total

stripePaymentIntentId.description: Stripe PaymentIntent ID for payment tracking

stripeChargeId.description: Stripe Charge ID after payment confirmation

notes.description: Optional buyer notes attached to the order

OrderItem.description: A single line item within an order. Captures price at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

creatorId.description: Denormalized creator ID for analytics queries

productTitle.description: Snapshot of product title at purchase time

productType.description: Snapshot of product type at purchase time

unitPrice.description: Price per unit at time of purchase (immutable)

downloadUrl.description: Signed download URL for digital products. Generated on order completion

downloadCount.description: Number of times file has been downloaded

Review.description: A rating and text review left by a user for either a product or a creator directly. Linked to orders for purchase verification.

targetId.description: ID of the product or creator being reviewed

orderId.description: Foreign key to orders.id. Set for product reviews to verify purchase

isVerified.description: True if reviewer has a confirmed purchase of the product

isHidden.description: Admin moderation flag to hide inappropriate reviews

helpfulCount.description: Number of other users who marked this review as helpful

SubscriptionPlan.description: Defines the available subscription tiers for both creators (platform access tiers) and users (premium access + user->creator subs). Managed by admin.

name.description: Plan display name e.g. 'Creator Pro Monthly'

description.description: Plan description shown on pricing page

type.description: CREATOR_TIER: creator platform plans, USER_PREMIUM: platform access for users, USER_CREATOR: user subscribing to a specific creator

tier.description: Applicable tier level for CREATOR_TIER and USER_PREMIUM plans

trialDays.description: Number of free trial days. Null = no trial

features.description: Array of feature strings displayed on pricing page e.g. ['Unlimited portfolios', '5% commission rate']

stripeProductId.description: Stripe Product ID corresponding to this plan

stripePriceId.description: Stripe Price ID used when creating subscriptions

isActive.description: Whether new subscriptions can be created on this plan

subscriptions.description: All active/historical subscriptions on this plan

Subscription.description: An active or historical subscription record linking a subscriber to a plan. Covers creator platform tiers, user premium, and user->creator subscriptions.

creatorId.description: Foreign key to creator_profiles.id. Only set for USER_CREATOR type subscriptions

currentPeriodStart.description: Start of current billing period (synced from Stripe)

currentPeriodEnd.description: End of current billing period (synced from Stripe)

trialEnd.description: When the trial period ends. Null if no trial

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: If true, subscription cancels at period end without renewal

stripeSubscriptionId.description: Stripe Subscription ID for webhook correlation

stripeCustomerId.description: Stripe Customer ID for this subscriber

Follow.description: A follow relationship between a user and a creator. Used for discovery feed and creator notification of new followers.

Media.description: Tracks all files uploaded to MinIO/S3 storage. Used for managing storage quotas, generating signed URLs, and cleanup.

url.description: Full public or pre-signed URL to the media

mimeType.description: MIME type e.g. image/jpeg, video/mp4, application/pdf

isPublic.description: Whether file is publicly accessible without auth

metadata.description: Additional file metadata e.g. EXIF data, processing status

uploadedBy.description: The user who uploaded this file

Notification.description: In-app and push notification records for users. Covers follows, purchases, subscription events, and system messages.

type.description: Notification category for icon and routing

data.description: Arbitrary payload for deep linking e.g. { orderId, productId, creatorId }

isRead.description: Whether user has read/dismissed this notification

readAt.description: When notification was marked as read

actionUrl.description: Deep link URL for tapping the notification

sentViaPush.description: Whether push notification was dispatched to mobile

Tag.description: Flat taxonomy of searchable tags across the platform. Used for product discovery and portfolio filtering.

name.description: Display name of the tag e.g. 'Bali'

usageCount.description: Number of entities using this tag (denormalized for autocomplete ranking)

imageUrl.description: Optional illustration for destination/style tags shown on explore page

Category.description: Hierarchical product and content categories. Supports parent-child nesting for sub-categories.

parentId.description: Self-referential foreign key to categories.id for sub-categories. Null = top-level

isActive.description: Whether category is visible in navigation

UserAddress.description: Saved addresses for a user. Used for physical product delivery and tax calculation.

street.description: Street address line 1 (and line 2 if needed)

state.description: State or province (optional for some countries)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code e.g. US, GB, AU

isDefault.description: Whether this is the user's default shipping address

CreatorAnalytics.description: Daily aggregated analytics snapshot for a creator. One row per creator per day, captured by a scheduled background job.

profileViews.description: Number of unique profile page views on this date

storefrontViews.description: Number of unique storefront page views

productViews.description: Total product detail page views across all products

portfolioViews.description: Total portfolio views on this date

revenue.description: Total revenue earned on this date

orderCount.description: Number of completed orders on this date

newFollowers.description: Net new followers gained on this date

newSubscribers.description: Net new paid subscribers on this date

conversionRate.description: Storefront views to orders conversion rate (computed)

creator.description: The creator this analytics snapshot belongs to
